question: Plants of which family have a highly compressed inflorescence branching system called a capitulum or flower head in which all the flowers are attached to a receptacle surrounded by unbranched bracts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asteraceae**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kingdom plants are divided into five groups- Algae, Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms, and Angiosperms.
 
• Angiosperms are divided into various families.
 
• **Asteraceae **is one of them.
 
• The family **Asteraceae **also known as **Compositae**, consists of over 32,000 known species of flowering plants in over 1,900 genera within the order Asterales.
 
• Examples: Chrysanthemum, Helianthus annus
 
• Helianthus annus is the botanical name of the sunflower.
